items.title: Netflix Bridges AWS IAM and Internal Identity with Workload Attestation
items.summary: Netflix has developed a workload attestation mechanism for Apache Spark jobs running on Amazon EMR. The design combines AWS IAM identity with signed claims from Netflix’s control plane before issuing short-lived internal X.509 certificates, allowing managed compute workloads to authenticate to internal services without directly injecting credentials. By Leela Kumili

items.title: Cilium 1.20 Expands Gateway API and Opens eBPF Datapath for Kubernetes
items.summary: Cilium 1.20 has been released with broader Kubernetes Gateway API support, an extensible eBPF datapath and further work on sidecarless mutual TLS. The release also makes the newer netkit network device easier to introduce across Kubernetes fleets that run different Linux kernel versions. By Matt Saunders

items.title: Vercel Labs Open-Sources fx: A Zig Coding Agent Designed to Be Embedded
items.summary: Vercel Labs has released fx, an experimental open-source coding agent written in Zig. It runs as a CLI, a script component, or an embedded library, including a WebAssembly build. Early feedback questioned its model-agnostic claim and a name conflict with an existing tool. Vercel says the project is pre-1.0 and changing quickly. By Daniel Curtis

items.title: Article: AI Changes the Data Interface, Not the Query Engine
items.summary: This article presents a disaster-recovery analytics workflow in which an AI agent generates constrained SQL or Python, DuckDB computes reproducible facts from Parquet, and the agent interprets the results. It explains the determinism split, replayable analysis, and four signals for deciding when an embedded engine is sufficient or a managed lakehouse is justified. By Peihao Yuan

items.title: Harbor Adds Docker Sandboxes to Run Reproducible AI Agent Evals in Isolated MicroVMs
items.summary: Docker announced that Harbor, the open-source agent evaluation framework, now works with Docker Sandboxes. This change allows each evaluation task to run in its own microVM. So, instead of sharing a container, tasks are isolated for better performance By Claudio Masolo

items.title: Anthropic zeigt Claude Duet: Wie der KI-Assistent Muse und Dots Konkurrenz machen soll
items.summary: Anthropic will Meta mit Muse und OpenAI mit Dots Konkurrenz machen. Dafür veröffentlicht das KI-Unternehmen jetzt seinen eigenen agentischen Assistenten. Was Claude Duet leisten und für wen es gedacht ist. weiterlesen auf t3n.de

items.title: Developer Behind the AI-Built Adobe Clones Says They Are “Not Anywhere Close to Ready
items.summary: A developer used Claude Opus 5.5 to build open-source replacements for seven Adobe applications, promoted them across Reddit with a projection of roughly 100% parity within a month, then told Hacker News the project was not anywhere close to ready. Its own roadmap puts it at 45% ready for real work and 2,300 to 4,100 agent-hours from full parity. By Steef-Jan Wiggers
